QF.id: VII Other Services Provided by Brokers_25

question.text: The principal officer of a portfolio manager must have relevant experience of at least:

answer.text: 5 years in related securities market activities, with at least 2 years in portfolio management, investment advisory services, or areas related to fund management

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series VII workbook (pages 253-254), the principal officer must have at least five years of experience in related activities in the securities market, including at least two years in portfolio management, investment advisory services, or areas related to fund management. The Trap: Both the total experience (5 years in related securities-market activities) and the specific 2-year experience in PM, IA, or fund management must be met. Fund management is part of the qualifying experience and should not be omitted. Note: Source: NISM Series VII workbook, pages 253-254.
